title: Bounded local acyclic monomorphisms detect all local lifting problems
statement: Fix a universe of small sets and the category $\mathrm{sS}=\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^{\mathrm{op}},\mathrm{sSet})$, Reedy model structure and simplicial mapping sets of [lem-coef-simplicial-space-reedy-cartesian]. Let $f:P\hookrightarrow Q$ be a monomorphism in $\mathrm{sS}$. Call $Z$ local if it is Reedy fibrant and $\operatorname{Map}(Q,Z)\to\operatorname{Map}(P,Z)$ is a weak homotopy equivalence [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper]. Let $T_f$ be the class of monomorphisms $i:A\hookrightarrow B$ for which $\operatorname{Map}(B,Z)\to\operatorname{Map}(A,Z)$ is a weak homotopy equivalence for every local $Z$. For a class $E$ of arrows, write $E^{\square}$ for the arrows with the right diagonal-lifting property against every member of $E$, as defined in [lem-coef-lifting-class-closure]. There is an uncountable small cardinal $\gamma$ such that, if $J_\gamma$ is any set of representatives of the isomorphism classes of arrows $i:A\hookrightarrow B$ in $T_f$ with $\left|\coprod_{p,q\geq0}B_{p,q}\right|<\gamma$, then $J_\gamma^{\square}=T_f^{\square}$. An isomorphism of arrows means a commutative square with invertible source and target maps. The cardinal $\gamma$ may depend on $f$, and is not asserted to be countable or independent of $P,Q$.

source.place: Rezk, A model for the homotopy theory of homotopy theory, Proposition 9.1 proof, final paragraph, printed p. 22: Bousfield-Smith bound for the generating local trivial cofibration. Replacing a degreewise bound by a total bound is harmless after increasing the uncountable cardinal. Read online; WANTED in report.md; no Stacks tag for this result.
